subject.title: Inject lease and run metadata into remote command environments

question: Should Crabbox establish `CRABBOX_LEASE_ID`, `CRABBOX_RUN_ID`, and `CRABBOX_SLUG` as a stable reserved environment contract for every remote command?
rationale: This adds durable user-facing names, precedence rules, and identifier lifecycles across all execution backends; implementation can be mechanical only after maintainers choose that public contract.

options.title: Adopt the core metadata contract
options.body: Define the three names centrally, make the CLI-generated run ID the coordinator-free default, and preserve coordinator IDs when available.

options.title: Limit metadata to coordinator runs
options.body: Expose only durable coordinator-backed run metadata and leave direct/static execution without a per-invocation namespace.

options.title: Defer public environment names
options.body: Avoid reserving variables until a broader execution-context API or compatibility policy is selected.

recommendation.title: Adopt the core metadata contract
recommendation.body: Define the three names centrally, make the CLI-generated run ID the coordinator-free default, and preserve coordinator IDs when available.
